game.name: Rock Band : Country Track Pack (USA)
game.desc: Rock Band: Country Track Pack for Xbox 360 offers a pack of new country songs for the game Rock Band. This music game puts you in a rock band. Using the special accessories, you can sit behind the drums, play the guitar or bass or even sing into the microphone. The pack includes 20 new songs, including Keith Urban, Kenny Rogers, Cross Canadian Ragweed and Brooks & Dunn.
